en.title: Let poems be simple
stanzas: Let poems be simple, and sound at everybody`s heart
Let every lip lift up a stanza of poem
Let poems roam about
Every meandering road in darkness and light
Every undulating land rivers forests hills mountains caves sky in day and night
In call of animals and birds, in all living and non-living things of the earth
Let poems flow with sonorous torrent of river
Let them shine like stars, celebrate the festival of light in the sky
Let them be melodious with ambrosial strains
Let poems thunder like clouds, make the heart of the earth drenched with drizzle
Like forest let them embosom the green
Like the sea let them fall in love with sailors, let them be sandbank for snails
Let poem be real
Like day and night like sunshine and wind
Like morning and evening like fire like water like earth
Like the blade of sword like life and death
Let poems be for rocks, yet not like rocks
Let them be for winter, yet not like winter
Let them be for the dead, yet not like the dead
Let them be for darkness, yet not like darkness
The feeling arisen by closeness of blood with blood, breast with breast, breath with breath
And the thrill arisen by the quivering of nerve vein bone breast
That light up the darkness of mind
Let poems shine amid them
Let poems be like roaming birds, let them rejoice the pleasure of wanderings
Let them bring news from horizon
Let them be source of nectar, let them bring sap from immaculate source
Let them bring colours from scenic frontier to insipid life
Let the strain and beauty of poem reverberate in every heart
Let poems be simple, not like leafless tree
Let poems be river, not stagnant water body.
Let poems be simple.
Translated by Dr. Binod Kumar Gogoi
